subject: Re: Kickoff: BAM - one multi-task NLU model to replace the classifier fleet
body:
Status + one risk.

GLUE reproduction done in April as planned (RTE and MRPC single-task baselines, then multi-task). Internal numbers as of this week: the multi-task student with born-again distillation matches or beats 9 of 11 production classifiers; average delta +0.6 F1. Maren's de-dup pass flagged ~3% of merged training utterances as cross-task near-dupes - removing them cost us 0.2 F1 on paper but the eval numbers are now actually trustworthy.

The risk: the two losing tasks are the low-resource ones (intent disambiguation, sarcasm). This matches the known multi-task pattern where small tasks get swamped. Rafael is testing teacher-annealing weights per task; if that doesn't close it by 6/19, the honest options are keeping 2 dedicated classifiers or accepting the regression.

Linnea
